# `base/otp-input`

A one-time code is entered as separate character cells.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A one-time code is entered as separate character cells.
- **Avoid when:** The code is pasted as one string into an ordinary field.
- **Consider instead:** `base/text-inputs`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { OtpInput } from "themelia-ui/base/otp-input"
import "themelia-ui/base/otp-input.css"
```

### `OtpInputProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `Omit<OTPField.Root.Props, "length">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `length` | no | `number` | How many characters. Six is the near-universal length. |
| `groupSize` | no | `number` | Splits the boxes into groups, for a code written as "123 456". |
| `invalid` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `strings` | no | `Partial<OtpInputStrings>` |  |

### `OtpInputStrings`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `fieldLabel` | yes | `string` | Names the field, and with it the first box. A caller's `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`<br>(or a surrounding `FormField`) replaces it. |
| `slotLabel` | yes | `(position: number, length: number) => string` | Names each remaining box by position. A numeric-only form can say so:<br>`strings={{ slotLabel: (n, of) => \`Digit ${n} of ${of}\` }}`. |
